title: Coconut Mousse with Australian Bushfood
description: A unique dessert incorporating Australian bushfood with the creaminess of coconut mousse.

ingredients.name: Coconut Cream
ingredients.notes: Chilled in the fridge before use.

ingredients.name: Australian Quandong Puree
ingredients.notes: Available at most health food stores.

ingredients.name: Coconut Sugar
ingredients.notes: Replace with regular sugar if not available.

ingredients.name: Unusual Saltbush Leaves
ingredients.notes: Only use a few leaves for flavor, as they can be strong.

instructions: In a blender, combine coconut cream, quandong puree, coconut sugar, lemon juice, saltbush leaves, and melted coconut oil. Blend until smooth.
In a separate bowl, whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form.
Fold the whipped egg whites into the coconut mixture until well combined.
Dissolve the gelatin in a small amount of water and add it to the mixture. Fold until the gelatin is fully incorporated.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate for at least 3 hours or until set.
Just before serving, top with additional coconut flakes or fresh fruit, if desired.
